_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Oli Mchezaji {player_id} mu katemba kya Liar's Dice kya {num_players}.
Nnono:
- Ku kikolwa chako, oyinza:
  1) Kuteka kikolwa kipya na obungi bwingi oba maadi mangi (oba byombi) kuliko kikolwa kiriko; yaani '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kuyita kikolwa kya mwisho kwa kutumia '[Call]'.

Bw'oyita:
  - Bw'obungi bw'dice bw'enkanya businga kikolwa, mchezaji wa mwisho afiirwa dice limo.
  - Oyinza, mchezaji atakayita afiirwa dice limo.
Mchezaji atakafikirwa 0 dice afiirwa. Mchezaji wa mwisho atawangula.

board.new_round:
Muzannyo mupya - Efumbi zisigalibwa: {dice_summary}
Efumbi zako za sasa ziri: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Omuzanyi {current_player_id} ayita! Omuwendo gw'amaziso ag'omuwendo {face_value} guli {count}, oguli wansi wa {quantity}.
Omuzanyi {loser_id} (eyali asabye) afiirwa kisolo kimo.
call.caller_loses:
Omuzanyi {current_player_id} ayita! Omuwendo gw'amaziso {face_value} gwa kweli ni {count}, ogusinga {quantity}.
Omuzanyi {loser_id} (eyayita) afiirwa kifo kimoja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Okuyita kuno kukoleddwa nga tewaliwo kusasulwa kwonna.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kuza kwakuwuliza tekutegekebwa kuwa '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]'. Kuza kwakutumwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Omuwendo omupya {new_quantity} mutono okusinga ogwa kati {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Omugaso omuggya {new_face_value} mutono okusinga ogwa kati {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Okuguza kuno kufaanagana n'okugabula okwomu kiseera kino.
bid_reason.face_range: Obukulu bw'ekika buteekwa okuba wakati wa 1 ne 6.
